description: On the table in front, there’s a clear plastic container, a colorful cube, a small blue rectangular pack near the back, gray tongs on the right, and a gray curved item near the front. The left hand stays resting on the left side while the right hand reaches forward toward the blue pack, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it slightly, moves it leftward over the clear container, and lowers it into the container before releasing and pulling back.
